visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey sweatshirt featuring a white bunny patch, sits in a brightly lit indoor playroom. She is focused on playing a small, mint-green toy piano with one hand. The background includes a white toy kitchen and wooden furniture. (2) A man with long dark hair tied back, wearing a white jacket over a black and white striped shirt, looks into the camera and smiles warmly. He is in the same playroom, with a cream-colored teepee tent and soft lighting visible behind him. (3) The camera focuses on the toy piano's white keys. Adult hands are seen applying small pieces of tape and using a black marker to label the keys with letters C, D, E, F, G, A, and B. The girl's small hand also touches the keys. (4) The girl is shown playing the labeled piano while looking at a music sheet placed on the stand. An adult hand points to the notes on the paper. The girl looks up at the camera and smiles, showing a missing front tooth. (5) A toddler in a brown fuzzy outfit crawls towards the piano and attempts to grab the music sheet. An adult hand gently restrains the toddler to prevent interruption. The girl continues to play despite the distraction. (6) The girl finishes her short performance and looks toward the off-screen adults, pointing at the keys. She is laughing and seems proud. The camera pans slightly to show the playroom environment including shelves of children's books and toys. (7) A simple 2D animation on a yellow background appears, showing a boy and girl sitting together with the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' displayed underneath in a playful font.
